web.scope: Version 2 released 26.10.2026, version 1 on 19.06.2026: all comments since version 1. Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions of both versions, llama.cpp, Ollama and mlx-vlm issues. Reddit not found. **Feedback thin for version 2.**
web.summary: Version 1 praised on Hacker News as very good and cheap to run locally, but one side-by-side test on a hard scan found it the fastest and the least faithful: it invented text. Almost no reports on version 2 yet.
web.verdict: Fast, liked on HN; invents text on hard scans (v1); v2 too new

comments.text: Version 1 judged very good and cheap to run on a decent computer ([HDBaseT, 30.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48740641); [Johnny_Bonk, 13.08.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49289852)); fits in 12 GB of VRAM and seems competitive ([potsandpans, 04.07.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48786469)).

Version 1, same hard low-resolution scan through five models: fastest but least faithful, it wrote plausible text that is not in the document; faithfulness order olmOCR-2, Qianfan-OCR, PaddleOCR-VL, HunyuanOCR, Unlimited-OCR. Tall pages need the cropping mode, otherwise it repeats itself ([rhirae, HF #3, 25.06.2026](https://huggingface.co/baidu/Unlimited-OCR/discussions/3)).

Version 1 breaks with recent vLLM and Transformers 5 after a config change; workaround by pinning an older revision ([HF #23, 16–30.10.2026](https://huggingface.co/baidu/Unlimited-OCR/discussions/23)).

Version 2 runs on Apple Silicon through the mlx-community build ([HF #2, 28.10.2026](https://huggingface.co/baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2/discussions/2)); users ask for Turkish and Arabic, more languages promised ([HF #1, 27.10.2026](https://huggingface.co/baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2/discussions/1)).
